cd /tmp && cat > bench1.py <<'EOF'
import sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import networkx as nx

random.seed(1)
NR=4096; NO=8192; PAIRS=262144
G=nx.DiGraph()
S='S'; T='T'
G.add_node(S, demand=0); G.add_node(T, demand=0)
# request quota tree: 200 nodes chain-ish
RQ=[('rq',i) for i in range(200)]
for i,n in enumerate(RQ):
    if i==0: G.add_edge(S,n,capacity=4096,weight=0)
    else: G.add_edge(RQ[i-1],n,capacity=4096,weight=0)
OQ=[('oq',i) for i in range(200)]
for i,n in enumerate(OQ):
    if i==0: G.add_edge(n,T,capacity=4096,weight=0)
    else: G.add_edge(OQ[i-1],OQ[i-1] if False else n,capacity=4096,weight=0)
# fix
G.remove_edges_from([(OQ[i-1],OQ[i-1]) for i in range(1,200)])
for i in range(1,200): G.add_edge(OQ[i],OQ[i-1],capacity=4096,weight=0)

requests=[('r',i) for i in range(NR)]
for i,r in enumerate(requests):
    G.add_edge(RQ[i%200], r, capacity=1, weight=0)
offers=[('o',i) for i in range(NO)]
for i,o in enumerate(offers):
    G.add_edge(o, OQ[i%200], capacity=1, weight=0)
pairs=set()
while len(pairs)<PAIRS:
    a=random.randrange(NR); b=random.randrange(NO)
    pairs.add((a,b))
    if len(pairs)>=PAIRS: break
pairs=list(pairs)[:PAIRS]
print('pairs built', len(pairs))
t=time.time()
for a,b in pairs:
    G.add_edge(requests[a], offers[b], capacity=1, weight=random.randrange(10**9))
print('build', time.time()-t, G.number_of_nodes(), G.number_of_edges())
t=time.time()
try:
    flowDict = nx.max_flow_min_cost(G, S, T)
    print('solve', time.time()-t)
except Exception as e:
    print('err', type(e).__name__, e, time.time()-t)
EOF
